name: H2H5: decisive fresh head-to-head - always-on irreversibility filter vs the policy, the latent safety filter as published and UNISafe
registered: 2026-10-27 23:24 EDT (draft; launched only after the user's go)
episodes: 600 fresh episodes 26200-26799 (never used by any run), paired across arms (same starts, same seeds), local RTX 3090, 6 shards
time_limit: 120 chunks = 96 s for every arm (TO2x showed 48 s mostly measures slowness); replay audit at the run's noise

conditions.1x: EXEC_NOISE_SCALE=1 (the arm's measured noise); filters with noise models imagine 1x (LSF_ALEA_SCALE=1); the published LSF has no noise model

arms.ours90: PRIMARY: always-on edit, value_irr8_alea.pt (fragile-irreversibility failure set, 0.8 s), barrier V' >= 0.9 V (LSF_CBF_GAMMA=0.1), gradient edit of the policy xyz <= 1 cm with the safety-actor fallback (policy_rollout lfc000 settings, as in all dev runs), every model step; selected by the pre-registered rule (results/jenga/irrm_a3_select.json, irrm_a4_select.json)
arms.ours80: SECONDARY: the same at V' >= 0.8 V
arms.lsf_pub: latent safety filter as published (value_pub_code.pt, authors' schedule, eps 0.2 by the LSF dev rule; failed the saturation criterion, reported as such)
arms.unisafe: UNISafe + noise-aware pessimism (value_unisafe_alea.pt, eps 0.30, worst of 8 noisy next latents; the strongest labelled baseline, lsfa030)

outcomes: neighbour topples, v4 and v4b successes, red-block drops before extraction, time-outs, edits / overrides per episode, compute per move
statistics: paired by episode, normal approximation one-sided 95%, exact McNemar (eval/h2h4_analysis.py functions)

primary_hypotheses.H1_2x_vs_policy: ours90 vs policy at 2x: fewer topples (one-sided McNemar p < 0.05) AND v4 lower 95% bound > 0
primary_hypotheses.H2_1x_no_cost: ours90 vs policy at 1x: v4 lower bound > -5 pp AND topples upper bound < +3 pp
primary_hypotheses.H3_2x_vs_unisafe: ours90 vs unisafe at 2x: non-inferior (topples upper < +3 pp; v4 and v4b lower > -5 pp)
primary_hypotheses.H4_2x_vs_lsf_pub: ours90 vs lsf_pub at 2x: fewer topples (one-sided McNemar p < 0.05)

secondary: the same tests for ours80; superiority of ours90 over unisafe; all comparisons at 1x; red-block drops; no multiplicity correction claimed for secondary results
not_included: psel (not runtime-worthy, user 2026-10-27); ablations (fragility value, gated edit, 1.6 s horizon) deferred to the end (user 2026-10-27)
order: 2x: policy, ours90, ours80, unisafe, lsf_pub; then 1x in the same order; audit each condition; analysis eval/h2h5_analysis.py (written before results are read)
